verdict.rationale: Blink is a native SSH/Mosh client built on libssh/libssh2. It connects straight to a server with `ssh [user@]hostname` or `mosh [user@]hostname`, using saved hosts and your own Ed25519/ECDSA/RSA keys. Tunnels and ProxyCommand are optional extras rather than requirements. A community user confirms direct LAN use with htop and tmux, and another reports solid connectivity. Missing for 10: an explicit first-party statement that no vendor cloud relay or account sits in the connection path.
